title_pt: Seis ovos de choique são apreendidos sob banco de veículo na Ruta Nacional 3
title_en: Six lesser rhea eggs seized from beneath a vehicle seat on National Route 3
title_es: Seis huevos de choique son decomisados bajo el asiento de un vehículo en la Ruta Nacional 3
card_text_pt: A Gendarmería encontrou seis ovos de choique sob o banco do passageiro durante fiscalização no km 1.812 da Ruta Nacional 3, em Chubut.
card_text_en: Gendarmería officers found six lesser rhea eggs beneath the passenger seat during a vehicle inspection at km 1,812 of National Route 3 in Chubut.
card_text_es: La Gendarmería encontró seis huevos de choique debajo del asiento del acompañante durante un control en el km 1.812 de la Ruta Nacional 3, en Chubut.
context_pt: Fatos documentados [O1]: A Gendarmería encontrou seis ovos de choique sob o banco do passageiro durante fiscalização no km 1.812 da Ruta Nacional 3, em Chubut. context_en: Documented facts [O1]: Gendarmería officers found six lesser rhea eggs beneath the passenger seat during a vehicle inspection at km 1,812 of National Route 3 in Chubut. Because the source records only the inspection point, no transport origin or destination is inferred. Evidence limits: 6 eggs, exact count. No specific route was inferred beyond the documented locality.
